newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel pins hopes on 127.94 trendline.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel pins hopes on 127.94 trendline.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF were wrestling with key trendline support at 127.94 on Thursday as they tried to consolidate before a longer term push down, analysts said.
"I think the market will consolidate a little ahead of a break to the downside," said Francoise Skelley, head of global trading technical analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston in London.
She said the market was weighing on a two-year uptrend on monthly continuation charts which comes in around 127.94 this session.
Notionnel were quoted at 128.04 at 0746 GMT, down 12 basis points on the day after dipping through the trendline to a 127.90 low.
Skelley said if the contract broke the trendline decisively it would target 127.54, a support line connecting the lows of January and April.
Below there, the April 4 low of 127.06 would come into play, Skelley said.
But she said the contract would initially try to consolidate, hitting light resistance at 128.40, then banging into the highs from Wednesday at 128.60,66.
The breakdown point around 128.80 from the top of the gap starting May 23, would cap any furhter upside move.
Longer term, Skelley targetted a push toward 124.00.
Simon Mattholie, proprietary trader at Deutsche Bank in London said the notionnel was looking in better shape than Bunds.
He noted minor resistance at 128.32, from a trendline connecting the highs from May 16 and May 28.
"If you break that than you're looking at the highs from yesterday at 128.66." he said.
At the short end, June Pibor futures were quoted at 96.25, up two basis points. September were quoted at 96.28, up two basis points.
